description: Scan a repo's open issues for stale claims: comments where someone said they would take an issue but never opened a PR. Buckets are FRESH (<14d), WATCH (14-44d), STALE (45-89d, contestable), DEAD (90d+). Call this to find issues you can legitimately claim because the last claimant walked away.

stale_days.description: Age in days that counts as stale (default 45)

name: stale_claims
